theses.thesis: The strongest non-extended setup combines net congressional buying by three members, strongly positive insider purchase behavior, a large patent cluster, and bullish social positioning [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. Its 60-day relative underperformance suggests the convergence has not already been priced through, although earnings in 12 days create event risk.
theses.thesis_zh: 这是最突出的未过度延伸标的：三名国会议员呈净买入、内部人购买指标强劲、专利集群显著，同时社交平台情绪偏多 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。过去60日相对大盘落后，说明该汇聚信号可能尚未被充分计价，但12个交易日内的财报构成事件风险。
second_order: AMAT — memory-capacity recovery would normally improve semiconductor-equipment demand, while its own patent and congressional signals provide separate support [patent_cluster] [congress_cluster]
Semiconductor equipment theme — sustained memory investment would transmit upstream to fabrication tools
theses.dissent: Negative 60-day relative strength may reflect deteriorating fundamentals rather than an unrecognized opportunity, and the upcoming earnings event could overwhelm the alternative-data signals.

falsifier.text: Insider buying ceases and the next earnings release shows weakening memory demand or reduced investment expectations.

SMCI — AI compute deployments can support server integration demand, though its evidence is more sentiment-driven [retail_buzz] [unusual_options]

theses.thesis: Consumer usage, developer momentum, model downloads, and patents independently point to durable platform engagement [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. theses.thesis: High app engagement, very large model-download activity, and developer momentum form a coherent usage-to-ecosystem signal [app_demand] [hf_model_momentum] [github_momentum]. Disclosed exposure associated with Nancy Pelosi adds a separate affiliation channel, while negative 60-day relative performance leaves the name unextended [actor:Nancy Pelosi].
theses.thesis_zh: 较高的应用参与度、庞大的模型下载量和开发者动能共同形成从用户需求到生态活跃度的连贯信号 [app_demand] [hf_model_momentum] [github_momentum]。与Nancy Pelosi相关的已披露持仓提供了另一条独立关联渠道，而过去60日相对表现为负，股价并未过度延伸 [actor:Nancy Pelosi]。

Data-center power infrastructure theme — expanding model usage implies greater compute and electricity requirements
Cloud software ecosystem — developer momentum can broaden demand for hosting, tooling, and data services

theses.thesis: Government-contract acceleration is the most economically direct signal in the pack and aligns with analyst upgrades plus disclosed political and fund affiliations [gov_contract_accel] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. second_order: Government software theme — sustained contract acceleration could indicate broader agency digitization demand
Cloud and AI infrastructure theme — deployment of government analytics workloads can increase secure compute requirements
MSFT — government AI adoption may benefit established secure-cloud platforms, though no direct contract linkage is supplied
theses.dissent: Extreme relative strength and uniformly bullish sentiment raise crowding and valuation-risk concerns, while the contract amount alone does not establish material earnings impact.

falsifier.text: Government-contract momentum reverses or fails to translate into sustained backlog and revenue growth.
